The heat hits me so much. I either guzzle all the coffee or have naps. Staying inside during the hottest hours of the day helps a lot.

We have talked about it but his sleepy brain forgets 😂. I'm on nortriptyline which calms my nerves down enough to sleep. Sometimes when he wakes me it's enough for my brain to notice my meds have stopped working and there is no more sleeping. Even just with a shrug off.

#MultipleSclerosis peeps with partner, I need your help. My husband sometimes wakes me up by accident first thing in the morning. He comes over for a cuddle but then I can't get comfortable again or my body decides his touch is painful. How do you prevent being angry at them?

Fatigue is my biggest obstacle today. I don't feel like I've had any rest at all and my body is so heavy. Just need to push through a few more days to get everything sorted in the new house. #MultipleSclerosis #fatigue

Tomorrow is my first day at school in Denmark!! I'm so scared of all the brain fog and forgetfulness. I have two note pads so I can write down everything. Just need to stay calm and hopefully make some new friends.

Oh that sucks! Another wee trick is when you have motivation, make big pots of food and freeze individual portions. Then is just a quick defrost and you have some home cooked food. Helps with low energy days too

Feeling pooped today. So bloody tired. How does everyone push through fatigue to get stuff done? Usually I try to drink more water and make a mini to do list but the motivational voice in my head is on holiday. #ms #MultipleSclerosis #fatigue
